hero_desc: The token that turns every click into global impact. Powered by the collective force of its holders, World Button (CLICK) is a decentralized utility token born from the vision of an ecosystem where global competition, philanthropy, and the digital economy converge in a single click.
hero_tagline: Play. Compete. Win. Every click changes the world. 🌍
about_desc: World Button (CLICK) is more than a token — it's a movement. A decentralized ecosystem where global competition, philanthropy, and the digital economy converge in a single click. Every interaction adds points, every season crowns a nation, every game changes something real in the world.
f1_desc: Every click adds points to your personal score and your country's ranking. At the end of each season, the nation with the most points is crowned champion. Tournament winners share prize pools defined in the published rules, and a defined share supports a charitable organization in the winning country — selected by DAO vote and executed by smart contract.
f2_desc: In addition to the global season, optional tournaments offer independent prize pools. Sign up, compete, and prove your skills. Each tournament is a new opportunity to claim part of the prize and climb the world ranking.
f3_desc: Your success depends on your dedication: daily streaks, click multipliers, and exclusive cosmetics you unlock through activity. CLICK rewards those who contribute the most, creating an economy where effort has real value.
f4_desc: A defined share of selected tournament prize pools goes to a charitable organization in the winning country — chosen by the community through DAO voting and executed on-chain by smart contract. Playing doesn't just benefit you — it changes the world.
f5_desc: Fixed maximum supply of 1,000,000,000 CLICK with transparent allocations. 50% of real net revenue buys back and burns CLICK — and every click powers the burn. No presale, no second token.
tk1_desc: An open launch on StonkFun with market-based price discovery. No presale, no ICO.
tk2_desc: Team tokens vest over 36 months with a 12-month cliff and linear monthly unlocks, aligning long-term incentives with the project.
tk3_desc: The project does not use Reward Mode and does not finance the team through a permanent tax on holder transactions.
tk4_desc: Only revenue actually received — creator fees when generated, marketplace activity, sponsorships — funds development, competitions and impact.
tk5_desc: 50% of net revenue actually received is used to buy CLICK on the open market and burn it permanently. Every verified click accumulates toward public burn milestones — playing directly reduces supply.
team_subtitle: The ones who make it happen. Four misfits rewriting the rules, one click at a time.
team_marco_desc: Founder. The crazy architect behind the vision. Converts caffeine into roadmaps and chaos into protocol. Believes one click can rewrite the world.
team_gustavo_desc: Cofounder. Uncorrectable creative. The bridge between wild ideas and real-world rules. Speaks fluently while keeping the community emotion alive. Makes sure we play hard but fair.
team_enrique_desc: The invisible hand behind every closed deal. Infiltrates institutions, reads the room before anyone speaks, and converts cold contacts into warm alliances. A commercial chameleon with incorruptible instincts.
team_luis_desc: The Swiss Army knife in person. One day coding, the next negotiating with suppliers, and Friday redesigning the web. No problem too weird, no task too random. If it exists, he can do it.
cta_desc: Be part of the movement. Play, compete, win and change the world — one click at a time.
